# `match`

## `match.end`

`match.end(value: Match[str], /, group: int | str = 0) -> int`

*filter*

Return the end index of a group.

- ``{{ '2026-11' | re.search('(?P<year>\\d+)-(?P<month>\\d+)-?(\\d+)?') | match.end(1) }}`` → ``4``

## `match.endpos`

`match.endpos(value: Match[str], /) -> int`

*attribute*

The `endpos` the search stopped at.

- ``{{ '2026-11' | re.search('(?P<year>\\d+)-(?P<month>\\d+)-?(\\d+)?') | match.endpos }}`` → ``7``

## `match.expand`

`match.expand(value: Match[str], /, template: str) -> str`

*filter*

Fill a `re.sub` style template (`\1`, `\g<name>`) from this match.

- ``{{ '2026-11' | re.search('(?P<year>\\d+)-(?P<month>\\d+)-?(\\d+)?') | match.expand('\\2/\\g<year>') }}`` → ``11/2026``

## `match.group`

`match.group(value: Match[str], /, *groups: int | str) -> str | tuple[str | None, ...] | None`

*filter*

Return one group (by number or name; 0 or nothing is the whole match), or a tuple.

- ``{{ '2026-11' | re.search('(?P<year>\\d+)-(?P<month>\\d+)-?(\\d+)?') | match.group }}`` → ``2026-11``
- ``{{ '2026-11' | re.search('(?P<year>\\d+)-(?P<month>\\d+)-?(\\d+)?') | match.group('month') }}`` → ``11``
- ``{{ '2026-11' | re.search('(?P<year>\\d+)-(?P<month>\\d+)-?(\\d+)?') | match.group(1, 2) | join('|') }}`` → ``2026|11``

## `match.groupdict`

`match.groupdict(value: Match[str], /, default: str | None = None) -> dict[str, str | None]`

*filter*

Return the named groups as a dict.

- ``{{ '2026-11' | re.search('(?P<year>\\d+)-(?P<month>\\d+)-?(\\d+)?') | match.groupdict | dictsort | map('join', '=') | join('|') }}`` → ``month=11|year=2026``

## `match.groups`

`match.groups(value: Match[str], /, default: str | None = None) -> tuple[str | None, ...]`

*filter*

Return every group; groups that did not take part get `default`.

- ``{{ '2026-11' | re.search('(?P<year>\\d+)-(?P<month>\\d+)-?(\\d+)?') | match.groups | join('|') }}`` → ``2026|11|None``
- ``{{ '2026-11' | re.search('(?P<year>\\d+)-(?P<month>\\d+)-?(\\d+)?') | match.groups('-') | join('|') }}`` → ``2026|11|-``

## `match.lastgroup`

`match.lastgroup(value: Match[str], /) -> str | None`

*attribute*

The name of the last group that matched, or None.

- ``{{ '2026-11' | re.search('(?P<year>\\d+)-(?P<month>\\d+)-?(\\d+)?') | match.lastgroup }}`` → ``month``

## `match.lastindex`

`match.lastindex(value: Match[str], /) -> int | None`

*attribute*

The index of the last group that matched, or None.

- ``{{ '2026-11' | re.search('(?P<year>\\d+)-(?P<month>\\d+)-?(\\d+)?') | match.lastindex }}`` → ``2``
- ``{{ 'a' | re.search('a') | match.lastindex }}`` → ``None``

## `match.pos`

`match.pos(value: Match[str], /) -> int`

*attribute*

The `pos` the search started from.

- ``{{ '2026-11' | re.search('(?P<year>\\d+)-(?P<month>\\d+)-?(\\d+)?') | match.pos }}`` → ``0``

## `match.re`

`match.re(value: Match[str], /) -> Pattern[str]`

*attribute*

The compiled pattern that produced this match.

- ``{{ '2026-11' | re.search('(?P<year>\\d+)-(?P<month>\\d+)-?(\\d+)?') | match.re | attr('groups') }}`` → ``3``

## `match.span`

`match.span(value: Match[str], /, group: int | str = 0) -> tuple[int, int]`

*filter*

Return `(start, end)` of a group.

- ``{{ '2026-11' | re.search('(?P<year>\\d+)-(?P<month>\\d+)-?(\\d+)?') | match.span | join('-') }}`` → ``0-7``
- ``{{ '2026-11' | re.search('(?P<year>\\d+)-(?P<month>\\d+)-?(\\d+)?') | match.span('month') | join('-') }}`` → ``5-7``

`match.start(value: Match[str], /, group: int | str = 0) -> int`

*filter*

Return the start index of a group.

- ``{{ '2026-11' | re.search('(?P<year>\\d+)-(?P<month>\\d+)-?(\\d+)?') | match.start(2) }}`` → ``5``
